##### Project general facts

Playa Viva is an exclusive coastal community, offering an elevated lifestyle where the gentle rhythm of the sea meets contemporary luxury. Featuring three interconnected residential towers with sleek architecture and expansive glass façades, the development is designed to maximize panoramic ocean views and natural light. This waterfront retreat stands as a symbol of refined living, where every detail is curated to reflect elegance, tranquility, and effortless comfort.

Beyond the residences, Playa Viva offers a resort-inspired lifestyle enriched by an impressive array of amenities. Residents enjoy access to a luxurious spa with signature treatments, a state-of-the-art gym, an outdoor cinema, a beachside pool, and watersports facilities, alongside a full suite of dining venues including gourmet restaurants and charming cafés. Supermarkets, salons, boutiques, and wellness centers are all just steps away, delivering the ultimate combination of convenience, coastal beauty, and refined island living.

Every residence at Playa Viva is fully furnished and equipped with a smart home system for a seamless modern experience. Interiors are beautifully crafted with clean, soft lines, neutral tones, and large windows that frame breathtaking sea vistas. Studios and one, two, and three-bedroom apartments combine functionality and aesthetics, creating private oases of serenity and sophistication. Kitchens are fully equipped, and each home is designed to be a sanctuary of comfort and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on Al Marjan Island, a stunning man-made archipelago in Ras Al Khaimah, this exceptional location is one of the region's most prominent tourist destinations. Known for its picturesque beaches, luxurious resorts, and upscale residential developments, the island is shaped like a coral reef with primary islands connected by a central boulevard, offering breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf.

The location is distinguished by its pristine white sandy beaches and crystal-clear waters, providing an ideal setting for sunbathing, swimming, and water sports. The island boasts a collection of luxurious hotels and resorts with world-class amenities, private beaches, swimming pools, spas, and gourmet dining options. Quick access to key points of the emirate, including the Wynn Casino, Al Hamra shopping center, and Ras Al Khaimah airport, enhances the area's appeal.

For those seeking a residence that embodies coastal elegance, island tranquility, and refined living, Al Marjan Island delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of natural beauty, world-class amenities, and a prime location makes it one of the region's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of seaside living — serene, sophisticated and effortlessly connected.
